policy: Only verified original card-specific files. Missing slots are silent and recorded separately. No wrong-character, generic, AI, procedural, or network fallback. Character playback pitch is always 1.0.

metadata_sources.scope: Metadata only. Legacy empty MINION sound arrays are mapped by ke() to Be(id)+_P/_A/_D. This is not proof audio files are accessible.

Retained general-archive filenames and conversion hashes. Old custom Harvest death is retained with global mapping disabled; current character slots use separately verified HearthPwn page-associated originals.
Public card-page audio elements and successful HTTP200 original OGG downloads, locally hashed and fully decoded. Source-language inference is labeled; no Chinese pack claim.

access_limit: Previously denied HearthSFX, Firestone CDN, CardSFX and wiki routes were not retried or bypassed. Newly discovered independent public HearthPwn card pages and linked media served original files with HTTP200.
